in_sanskrit.name: Amitesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Immeasurable, Infinite
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Amitesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Amitesh is a Sanskrit name, derived from 'Ami' meaning immeasurable and 'Tesh' meaning divine, god. It signifies a limitless, infinite being. In Hindu mythology, Amitesh is the name of various gods and goddesses, signifying the infinite and the unchanging.
